specs.title: Payment with the wallet

steps.title: 1. Open the basket, check out and continue with the saved address
2. Select `Standard Delivery` and click `Continue`
3. Read the wallet pay button
4. Open `Order History` from the account menu
5. Open `Digital Wallet` from the account menu
Precondition: add 3.99 to the wallet with the saved card
6. Check out again with the saved address and `Standard Delivery`
7. Click the wallet pay button
8. Click `Place your order and pay`
9. Open `Digital Wallet` from the account menu
10. Open `Order History` from the account menu
